# Muse Transit Connector

An MCP server that gives your Muse real-time public transit information: nearby stops, upcoming departures with live delays and cancellations, simple direct trips, and active service alerts — powered by Transitland's aggregation of GTFS feeds from 2,000+ agencies worldwide. The server is stateless and holds no user credentials. Honest heads-up: you deploy the server yourself and need a free Transitland API key — developer-oriented.
